posts.cooked:
So...the Fixed Point card from the Time Cataclysm states that basically for one round, until the start of the next environment turn, all cards are indestructible. We ran into this card while fighting La Capitan last night and we ran into some interesting questions during that one round.

If villian targets have their HP reduced to 0 in such a round, they hang about until their no longer indestrucatble, correct?

More over, what happens if a Player card is reduced to 0 in that situation? Does the hero still act, sort of playing powers and cards from a undeath limbo? Cause I tell you what, we were confused. Also kind of desperately trying to heal that one player too. Heh.

We may have handled it wrong, but it certainly was a strange situation.

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
As long as Fixed Point is in play, nothing is destructable, so everything stays in play and plays as normal.

As soon as Fixed Point leaves play, anything with 0 or fewer gets destroyed and player cards would flip to incapped (you should track negative HP with Fixed Point to account for healing).
